crossRefs.note: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’
He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female…
Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t…
Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go…
Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Philistine king who interacted with Abraham and Isaac

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Sarah
people.line: Wife of Abraham; mother of Isaac

translations.web: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.
translations.bsb: So Abimelech brought sheep and cattle, menservants and maidservants, and he gave them to Abraham and restored his wife Sarah to him.
translations.kjv: And Abimelech took sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and womenservants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
translations.asv: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants, and gave them unto Abraham, and restored him Sarah his wife.
